clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Sara Balloo grieves for her husband, Sully. Unable to face King Magni Bronzebeard, she asks you to carry her appeal to him.

Sara Balloo mourns Sully after receiving the final letter recovered from the waters of the Thandol Span. She wants his sacrifice remembered, so she writes a plea for King Magni Bronzebeard. Grief keeps her from appearing before the throne herself, and she entrusts the sealed letter to you, a champion of the Alliance, to carry it to the king.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, I have but a small request to ask of you.

Take this note I have prepared to our great monarch of Ironforge, King Magni Bronzebeard. 'Tis a small task to ask of one such as yourself, someone who has shown great valor to the cause of the Alliance thus far.
For me to go before the King in my grief-ridden state would not serve the purpose of my cause. Surely you understand.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So you are friend the adventurer? News of your contributions to the Alliance has traveled quite far, you know?
On what business do you come before me today?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It will take but a moment for me to peruse this letter...
